reproduction.behaviour: Fetches the three public archives into memory, reads the specified members without filesystem extraction, checks hashes/lengths/PE-or-ELF headers/markers and prints JSON. Does not execute downloaded content. --package selects one recorded package.
reproduction.interpretation: Matching evidence identifies the inspected artifacts; it is not a convolution correctness, performance, licensing-compliance or compatibility test. Upstream downloads may change, producing a mismatch.
